import argparse,json,html from pathlib import Path from .core import load_models,aggregate,paired,compare_summary,write_csv,group_map_pairs,binary_metrics def main(): p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description='汇总已有模型结果，不执行训练或临床诊断') sub=p.add_subparsers(dest='command',required=True) a=sub.add_parser('report');a.add_argument('input',type=Path);a.add_argument('--reference',required=True);a.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True) a=sub.add_parser('maps');a.add_argument('input',type=Path);a.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True) a=sub.add_parser('metrics');a.add_argument('input',type=Path) args=p.parse_args() try: if args.command=='metrics': d=json.loads(args.input.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));print(json.dumps(binary_metrics(d['y'],d['p']),indent=2));return args.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) if args.command=='maps': rows=group_map_pairs(args.input);write_csv(args.out/'group_map_comparisons.csv',rows);print(json.dumps(dict(comparisons=len(rows))));return rows=load_models(args.input);means=aggregate(rows);deltas=paired(rows,args.reference);comparisons=compare_summary(deltas) write_csv(args.out/'method_metrics.csv',means);write_csv(args.out/'paired_differences.csv',deltas);write_csv(args.out/'comparisons.csv',comparisons) info=dict(evaluation_rows=len(rows),reference=args.reference,step=rows[0]['step'],means=means,comparisons=comparisons,scope='保存模型的同协议固定时点比较；模型行数不等于独立患者数。未从模型间离散度推算临床区间。') (args.out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(info,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8') def table(data,columns): return ''+''.join('' for k,t in columns)+''+''.join(''+''.join('' for k,t in columns)+'' for r in data)+'
'+html.escape(t)+'
'+html.escape(f'{r[k]:.6f}' if isinstance(r[k],float) else str(r[k]))+'
' cols=[('variant','方法'),('models','保存模型数'),('auc','AUC'),('ap','AP'),('ba','BA'),('brier','Brier 越低越好'),('logloss','logloss 越低越好')] comp=[('variant','方法'),('reference','参照'),('delta_auc','AUC变化'),('delta_brier','Brier变化'),('delta_logloss','logloss变化')] content='保存模型结果比较

保存模型结果比较

'+html.escape(info['scope'])+'

固定更新次数 '+str(info['step'])+'。参照方法 '+html.escape(args.reference)+'。读取 '+str(len(rows))+' 条保存评价记录。

方法指标

'+table(means,cols)+'

配对变化

'+table(comparisons,comp)+'

概率误差下降与AUC提高分别解释；独立验证及原人员条件区间请结合原研究报告。

下载方法指标　下载全部配对变化　下载结果摘要

' (args.out/'report.html').write_text(content,encoding='utf8') (args.out/'report.txt').write_text('保存模型结果比较\n'+info['scope']+'\n\n'+json.dumps(info,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8') print(json.dumps(dict(evaluation_rows=len(rows),methods=len(means),paired_records=len(deltas),out=str(args.out)),ensure_ascii=False)) except (ValueError,KeyError,OSError) as e:p.error(str(e)) if __name__=='__main__':main()
